# Rainmakers

> Rainmakers does innovation advisory and open venture building, in Milan since 2011 (under the name Nuvolab until 2021). It works only on meaningful innovation — technology with a purpose, for our country, people and the planet — and, as its not-for-profit giveback, it created Italian Rainforest, the map of the Italian innovation ecosystem.

"We make large companies innovative and innovative companies large." Purpose: saving our country in a single generation through impact, entrepreneurship and innovation. Founder: Francesco Inguscio.

## Who it is for
Founders and entrepreneurs of startups, scaleups and SMEs, intrapreneurs and innovation managers. Investors, corporates and innovation professionals are welcome too.

## How Rainmakers is built
- Advisory — Innovation: innovation advisory for SMEs, corporates and investors (40+ projects since 2011). Investment: advisory for VC funds, CVCs and family offices.
- Open Venture Building — Accelerator: venture acceleration for startups after product-market fit. Builder: venture building for in-house projects (30+ startups launched in every sector).
- Giveback (our CSR) — StartuParty and Junior Jedi, among 10+ not-for-profit initiatives for Italy's innovation ecosystem; Rainmakers also created Italian Rainforest (below).

Meaningful innovation serves the 3 Ps: our country, people and the planet.

## Rainmakers and Italian Rainforest
Rainmakers is the organisation: people, experience and relationships. Italian Rainforest (https://italian-innovation-map.vercel.app/en) is a separate, not-for-profit project created by Rainmakers: the map and database of the Italian innovation ecosystem (investors, incubators and accelerators, corporate VC, startup studios, coworking spaces, institutions and other innovation enablers), open data for non-commercial use.

## Track record
- Open Venture Building (the Tribe startups): https://www.rainmakers.it/en#tribe
- Advisory projects (e.g. Le Village by Crédit Agricole, Assolombarda, University of Milano-Bicocca, Intesa Sanpaolo, 360 Capital Partners): https://www.rainmakers.it/en#advisory
- Giveback initiatives: https://www.rainmakers.it/en#giveback-initiatives
